title: pteris cadieri var. hainanensis
intro: Pteris cadieri var. hainanensis, commonly known as Hainan Brake Fern, is a type of fern plant that belongs to the genus Pteris. This plant is traditionally used in folk medicine, particularly in China, to treat various health issues. The Hainan Brake Fern is known for its health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help to alleviate conditions such as arthritis and skin irritation. The bioactive constituents of Pteris cadieri var. hainanensis include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and hepatoprotective effects.
